quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: When passing an emergency vehicle stopped on the side of the road, what should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane away from the emergency vehicle, or slow down.
Ask the emergency worker if they need help.
Move closer to the emergency vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane away from the emergency vehicle, or slow down.
questions.explanation: You must move away from the emergency vehicle to another lane if you can do so safely. If you cannot move over, you must slow down.

questions.question: When should you turn off your turn signal?

options.text: When there are no other cars around you.

questions.explanation: Turn on your signal before you start to turn so other drivers know your plans. Turn off your signal after you finish turning.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid crashes when driving on ice or snow?

options.text: Add weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highway as soon as you can.
Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snow or ice. Slowing down and keeping more distance between you and other cars are the best ways to avoid crashes in these conditions.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between traffic lanes mean?

options.text: You can pass, even if it might be unsafe.
You can pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You can cross dashed white lines to pass or change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Drive the same way you do on dry roads.

questions.explanation: On slippery roads, stay farther behind other cars. Your vehicle will take longer to stop than it does on dry roads.

questions.question: When can you cross a dashed white line?

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross them to pass or change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at a four-way stop sign at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver can go without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if two drivers arrive at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way. You can then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Why does driving at night require more caution?

options.text: There are more cars on the road at night.
It is harder to see at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is harder to see at night.
questions.explanation: At night, it is darker and you cannot see as well as during the day. You must use your headlights from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise, or when people and vehicles cannot be seen for 500 feet.

questions.question: How much lane space are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: The full lane width, the same as other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The full lane width, the same as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use the full width of a lane, just like other vehicles.

questions.question: What do your brake lights tell other drivers?

options.text: You have your emergency brake on.
You are slowing down or stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are slowing down or stopping.
questions.explanation: Your brake lights tell other drivers that you are slowing down or stopping. Always keep your brake lights in good working order.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, what must you do?

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane to use.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Allow the motorcycle to use only half a lane.
Pass the motorcycle while staying in the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane to use.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full-size vehicle with the same rights as any other vehicle. Give motorcyclists a full lane width. Even if there seems to be room for both vehicles in one lane, the motorcycle needs space to move safely.

questions.question: When you turn right on a green light, what must you do?

options.text: Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You may turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says otherwise. When you turn, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: What is true about drowsy drivers?

options.text: They should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
They can drive so poorly that they look drunk.
They can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.
They are usually only older drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can drive so poorly that they look drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so poorly that they look drunk. Opening a window, turning up the radio, or drinking coffee is not enough to fix drowsy driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, it means no right turn.

questions.question: What is important when you change lanes?

options.text: Make sure the lane is clear before you move.

questions.explanation: Always signal before you change lanes or exit. Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before you move left or right.

questions.question: When can a driver stop on railroad tracks?

options.text: If their car is crossing but cannot completely clear the tracks.
If they do not hear a train nearby.
If the gate is not down.

questions.explanation: Never stop on railroad tracks. If your car stalls on the tracks and you cannot restart it, get out and push it off. If you cannot push it, get help. Do not cross railroad tracks unless your car can completely clear them.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on slippery roads?

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: What happens to fines for traffic violations in construction zones?
questions.explanation: In Texas, fines for traffic violations in construction or maintenance zones are doubled when workers are present and warning signs are posted.

questions.question: When it starts to rain while you are driving, what should you do?

options.text: Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Stay close behind the car in front of you.

questions.explanation: When rain makes it hard to see, slow down. Turn on your headlights so other drivers can see you. If rain is too heavy to see clearly, pull to the side and stop until it clears.

questions.question: When may you drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road?

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or have any alcohol in a vehicle on a public road or sidewalk. You also cannot have an open alcohol container in the driver or passenger area of a vehicle on any public road.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: Shaded areas freeze faster than other parts of the road. They are also the last areas to dry. Be extra careful on shaded roads in cold or wet weather.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to allow approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to get out of your way.
Must honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to give you room.
Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
Can disregard any pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the street from a driveway. Wait until the path is clear of pedestrians and vehicles. Stop before crossing the sidewalk area.

questions.question: When it starts to sleet or snow while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clear.
Leave more space between your vehicle and the vehicles ahead of you.

questions.explanation: In snow and sleet, keep your windshield and mirrors clean. Increase your following distance because slippery roads require more space to stop. Drive carefully near other vehicles.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light, you should:
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light warns you of a hazard. Slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: You may cross double solid yellow lines:
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can cross them only to turn left into a driveway, to turn onto a highway, or to make a legal U-turn.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on white background
Black letters or symbols on yellow background
White letters or symbols on blue background
White letters or symbols on green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: A steady yellow light means:

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and get ready to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, continue through with caution.

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area:

options.text: You cannot see without turning your head.
You can see in your rearview mirror.
You can see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without moving your head. They are located to the sides of and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells you to drive with caution.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign is used only to mark a no passing zone.
